metadata.title: WeatherBridge models and standalone inference
metadata.description: Trained weights and standalone inference code for WeatherBridge and five comparison checkpoints used in the accompanying global weather interpolation study. The release includes 6 h and 12 h WeatherBridge weights, five 6 h comparison models, normalization statistics, static fields, a real ERA5 smoke-test window, checksums, and executable release tests. Full ERA5 and IFS HRES archives are not redistributed.
